heading.zh-Hant: 從譯員到駐荷、駐俄公使
heading.en: From interpreter to minister at The Hague and St. Petersburg

body.zh-Hant: 總理衙門派陸徵祥到聖彼得堡任職。他於1906年被任命為駐荷蘭公使，1908年這項任命獲重新確認，1911年起為駐俄公使；同年10月23日，他加入天主教。
body.en: Lu Zhengxiang was assigned by the Zongli Yamen to St. Petersburg. He was appointed minister to the Netherlands in 1906, his appointment was renewed in 1908, and he served as minister to Russia from 1911. On 23 October 1911 he joined the Roman Catholic Church.

citations.quote: Lu Cheng-hsiang was assigned by the Tsungli Yamen to St. Petersburg

body.zh-Hant: 1912年3月，陸徵祥獲任命為外交總長。唐紹儀辭去總理後，他於6月29日接任；9月18日他辭去外交總長，9月21日辭去總理。梁如浩於11月13日辭職後，他再度出任外交總長；1913年5月20日中俄協定簽署，9月他辭職。
body.en: In March 1912 Lu was appointed minister of foreign affairs. After Tang Shaoyi resigned the premiership he succeeded him on 29 June; on 18 September he resigned as foreign minister and on 21 September as premier. After Liang Ruhao resigned on 13 November 1912, Lu was reappointed foreign minister; a Sino-Russian agreement was signed on 20 May 1913, and in September he resigned.

heading.zh-Hant: 二十一條、再任外長與巴黎和會
heading.en: Twenty-One Demands, return to office and the Paris Peace Conference

body.zh-Hant: 1915年1月陸徵祥回到北京；孫寶琦辭職後，他再任外交總長，並於5月25日在二十一條最後協議上簽字。馮國璋任總統、王士珍任總理後，他又任外交總長，直到1920年12月。1919年1月他率代表團出席巴黎和會，代表團拒絕在凡爾賽和約上簽字。
body.en: Lu returned to Peking in January 1915; after Sun Baoqi resigned he resumed office as foreign minister and on 25 May 1915 signed the final agreement on the Twenty-One Demands. After Feng Guozhang became president with Wang Shizhen as premier, he served again as foreign minister until December 1920. In January 1919 he headed the delegation to the Paris Peace Conference, which refused to sign the Treaty of Versailles.

heading.zh-Hant: 流亡青年與巴拉圭軍團
heading.en: Exile, legal studies and the Paraguayan Legion

body.zh-Hant: 費雷拉生於利姆皮奧，幼年隨家人遷往阿根廷，在布宜諾斯艾利斯大學攻讀法律，並加入反對洛佩斯父子政權的巴拉圭流亡激進派。1864年三國同盟戰爭爆發時，他協助把這個團體改編為巴拉圭軍團，在阿根廷人入侵巴拉圭時並肩作戰。1870年索拉諾·洛佩斯戰敗。
body.en: Ferreira was born in Limpio and moved with his family to Argentina at an early age. He studied law at the University of Buenos Aires and joined radical Paraguayan exiles opposed to the López regime. When the War of the Triple Alliance broke out in 1864 he helped turn the group into the Paraguayan Legion, which fought alongside the Argentines in their invasion of Paraguay; Solano López was defeated in 1870.

body.zh-Hant: 1904年自由黨革命成功後，費雷拉被召回亞松森。他在缺乏民眾支持的情況下，於兩年後被任命為總統（1906–1908）；新的叛亂迅速演變為全面內戰。1908年7月他被迫下台並離開巴拉圭，最後死於布宜諾斯艾利斯。
body.en: After the successful Liberal revolt of 1904 Ferreira was recalled to Asunción. Without major popular support he was appointed president two years later (1906–1908); new revolts quickly coalesced into full-scale civil war. In July 1908 he was forced from office and from Paraguay for good, and he died in Buenos Aires.

people.nameZh: 穆斯塔法·阿卜杜勒哈利克·倫達

heading.zh-Hant: 奧斯曼時期地方官與流放

body.zh-Hant: 雷恩達1907年3月10日出任亞尼納省泰佩德連縣縣長，其後歷任多處縣長與州長（mutasarrıf），並任比特利斯、阿勒頗省長。1917年5月18日他出任內政部次長；1920年6月7日因英國人的指控被流放馬爾他，1921年10月25日返國。
body.en: Renda was appointed district governor of Tepelena in Janina province on 10 March 1907, then served as district governor and sanjak governor (mutasarrıf) in several places and as governor of Bitlis and Aleppo. He became Undersecretary of the Interior on 18 May 1917; on 7 June 1920 he was exiled to Malta on British accusations, and he returned on 25 October 1921.

heading.en: 1922–1923: governor of Konya and Izmir, elected deputy

body.zh-Hant: 1922年3月18日，雷恩達先以代理身分出任康亞省長，同年4月29日正式任命；9月19日改任伊茲密爾省長，被稱為解放後該市首任省長。1923年7月30日，他當選為昌克勒（Çankırı）議員。
body.en: Renda was first made acting governor of Konya on 18 March 1922 and confirmed on 29 April; on 19 September 1922 he was appointed governor of Izmir, described as the city's first governor after liberation. On 30 July 1923 he was elected deputy for Çankırı.

heading.en: Deputy, minister and Speaker of the Assembly

body.zh-Hant: 雷恩達共七屆擔任昌克勒議員，期間出任財政部長、國防部長與大國民議會議長。阿塔圖克去世後，他曾代理總統一天；1946年6月卸下議長職務。
body.en: Renda served seven terms as deputy for Çankırı and held the finance and national defence portfolios and the speakership of the Grand National Assembly. After Atatürk's death he served for a single day as president; in June 1946 he left the speakership.

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍軍官、民主黨人與殖民地部長
heading.en: Naval officer, Democrat and minister of the colonies

body.zh-Hant: 加斯帕爾是海軍軍官，政治上起初屬佛朗哥派，共和國建立後成為民主黨黨員。他曾在多屆政府擔任殖民地部長：1914年12月12日至1915年1月25日、1915年7月22日至11月29日、1915年11月29日至1916年3月15日、1919年6月30日至1920年1月3日，以及1922年2月7日至1923年11月15日。
body.en: Gaspar was a naval officer who began his political career as a Francoist and, after the Republic was established, joined the Democratic Party. He was minister of the colonies in several governments: 12 December 1914 to 25 January 1915, 22 July to 29 November 1915, 29 November 1915 to 15 March 1916, 30 June 1919 to 3 January 1920 and 7 February 1922 to 15 November 1923.

body.zh-Hant: 1924年7月6日至11月22日，加斯帕爾出任部長會議主席（政府首腦），並兼管內政部。這是葡萄牙第一共和國的第34屆政府，歷時139天。
body.en: From 6 July to 22 November 1924 Gaspar was President of the Ministry (head of government), also holding the interior portfolio. It was the 34th republican government and lasted 139 days.
